newsitem.title: USA: GM supports air bag safety moves.
newsitem.headline: GM supports air bag safety moves.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Friday it supports federal safety regulators in proposing revisions that would allow automakers to "de-power" air bags to make them The No. 1 U.S. automaker said in a statement that its seven vehicle divisions will begin mailing air bag warning letters to consumers in December.
The letters will contain warning labels that the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration wants to make mandatory for future vehicles.
GM made no mention if it plans to offer de-powered air bags in its vehicles. Both Ford Motor Co and Chrysler Corp said they will put air bags with a reduced explosive force in vehicles.
A GM spokesman could not be reached for comment.
Federal regulators have received reports that the force of deploying air bags can kill children and adults of small stature.
